title: Amazing sounds, really bad service and app
body:
I have been using brain waves for over 2 years and I really love the sounds and how well they work. The team have done a great job. 

When it comes to customer service it seems none existent. I have sent a number of emails regarding issues I was having with the app and have never received any communication back. I’m a yearly subscriber paying good money for the service and I’m getting no support. 

First issue: 
Sleep mode is forever stopping before the timer is up. 

Second issue:
When you start a session the timer starts and continues even if you spend 5 mins searching for the right sound. It should reset the timer when you skip tracks. 

Third issue:
The app is always logging me out and saying my session has expired. I don’t see any use for this at all. 

Fourth issue: 
When the session expires it no longer lets me log in and tells me my log in details are incorrect. The only way I can fix this is by reinstalling the app. This is very annoying especially when you are about to sit down for a calming meditation. 

Fifth issue: 
when I try and reset my password it tells me my email is incorrect. 

Sixth issue: 
Uppercase enabled in email field and unable to change a single character. 

Seventh issue: Still no landscape support for iPad. 

This app could be one of the best out there if these smaller details are addressed. It’s expensive and people should get what they pay for. This is the most expensive app I have in my account and it gives me the most issues. Please address them or I will be canceling my account and trying something else.

author: Psfl

title: Good app but needs improvements
body:
The sounds in this app are not your average Spotify or Apple Music playlists for studying or focus; they really work. For me, it both a timer and sound source. The issues I encounter, however subtle, need to be mentioned:

1. Horizontal screen: this app desperately needs a horizontal screen for the iPad version. Since the iPad is mostly used horizontally with the keyboard, it’s best to make this app available in horizontal so that we don’t have to rotate our neck (when on keyboard) or the ipad in order to access the app (although it is usable) 

2. A nicer user experience
More appealing and minimalistic user interface would change this app dramatically; there are apps with great UX but sounds are no good. The case is the opposite with this app; the interface is tolerable but it’s more like a web app rather than a mobile experience (the app on the web itself is good.) I believe with a redesign of an interface, the app would be the best amongst its competitors.

3. Being able to download all the sounds at once: sometimes you don’t have internet connection but need to focus; if you haven’t previously downloaded anything manually, you cannot listen to anything. It’s good to make an option of downloading sounds so that we don’t rely on internet connection.

4. Menu bar Mac app
This does not need mentioning; most focus/productivity apps in Mac offer the user a menu bar icon so that they don’t have to open their browser and wait for the sounds to load. I’d suggest at first, it’s a good idea to implement a native Mac app.

For the money we are paying, we could get better value :) 

Thank you to the great and hard working team.

body: Brain.fm offers 10 free trials but when you try to get the first one it takes you directly to Upgrade. Unable to access any free trial. Shameless scam.
author: Archaeophile

title: Doesn't let me try sleep or meditation
body: Doesn't let me try sleep or meditation in the free version. I'm not remotely inclined to pay for the app unless i can see if it actually works.
author: J.Dick

title: Great for work focus
body:
I use this mostly when I need to focus in the workplace and am blocking out distractions. I used up my free package over a couple of months so was happy to pay to keep the access. Since then I've used the sleep & nap only a couple of times.
With the sleep package, I'd like to see it for timeframes under 6 hours, especially as I like to use these as a means to help get to sleep but I don't want to be plugged in for at least 6 hours. For this reason, I'm more inclined to use the 'Nap' stream just so I can use it for 30-45 mins.
author: Bec_in_Oz

title: Insufficient tracks to sample
body: Wanted to review the 'meditation' and 'sleep' sound tracks, but the free version only provides sound tracks for 'focus'. Guys you'd be better off providing a few free tracks of 'each' of the areas you cover rather than 10 free tracks all in the one area. Not being able to sample a meditation or sleep track doesn't inspire me to purchase the app. Sorry...

author: Dale Clifford

title: Good start
body:
Good for a newish service, especially if you can get paid sub for a discount
Would like to see:
- more variation in long tracks
- more melody
- more controls over individual elements in a track
Not working so well:
- mismatch between the Home and Explore CX

But overall, have been using at work for 2 weeks and haven't touched another music source
